# Khaddar Virsa

> Khaddar Virsa sells premium, 100% chemical-free Kamalia khaddar suit fabric for men, with free delivery and Cash on Delivery across Pakistan and 15-day returns. Based in Lahore, Pakistan.

## Pages

- [Shop](https://www.khaddarvirsa.store/shop): all unstitched men's khaddar suits with prices in PKR
- [Collections](https://www.khaddarvirsa.store/collections): suits grouped by collection
- [Our Story](https://www.khaddarvirsa.store/our-story): who we are and how our khaddar is woven
- [Fabric Care](https://www.khaddarvirsa.store/fabric-care): washing and care instructions for khaddar
- [Contact](https://www.khaddarvirsa.store/contact): phone +92 342 4307737, 5 Jahangir Road, Ganj Mughalpura, Lahore
- [Track Order](https://www.khaddarvirsa.store/track-order): check the status of an order
